Name: Uz, Son of Aram
Summary: Uz was a son of Aram and a grandson of Shem, named in the Table of Nations.
KeyStory: Uz appears among Aram's sons, one of the branches of Shem's line after the flood.
RelatedPeople: Aram, Son of Shem; Hul; Gether; Mash
LifeLesson: God's promise to fill the earth moved forward through families like this one.
